book.title: Lepran Ɗe Pool Ran Nen Filipi Mo

content: Wu Sham Kǝ Kaa Koo Mǝ Kristi Sǝ
Katɗang seen fuu ɗe mo nɗǝǝn Jesu Kristi mo ɗee a ɗeɓal. Katɗang wal wur nǝ jwan wun, katɗang wuu shaar ashak kǝ Riin wur, katɗang wuu naajeel shak kǝcin ɗeret shak,
ɓe wu le kǝ retnyit fen nǝ gam, kǝ pan fuu mo ɗee a ɗemǝndong kǝ wal fuu nǝ ɗee a ɗemǝndong kǝ pǝtuup fuu mo ɗee a ɗemǝndong nɗǝǝn mbii mo jir.
Taji wu cìn mee mbii mbǝ rǝɓetkáa kǝ ɗiyeepkáa kas, ɗangɓe wu sham kǝ káa fuu mo. Wu shin ɗeɗes nshak met nkáa fuu mo.
Taji memee fuu ɗee ntap a mbii ɗe mo a mǝkáa fin ɓejee ɗak kas, ɗangɓe wun ntap kǝ mbii mǝ nyee fuu mo zak.
Wu yit kǝ mǝse fuu mo ɗee a kaa mǝse Jesu Kristi wur kǝ nǝ.

content.text: Jesu ɗewur a ɗemǝndong kǝ Naan,
lekáa fin nciit-nciit kǝ Naan kas. Ɗang baa a mbii ɗewur nyaa nǝ rip shiɓal kǝ wur ɗee ɗi kaa Naan sǝ kas.
Ɗangɓe Jesu wur sham kǝ káa fin,
har wur leshin a káa kǝrem sǝ.
Ɗangɓe kaaɗi gyet wur ɗe nɗǝǝn nan kaa gurum sǝ,
ɓe wur sham kǝ káa fin,
kǝ wur shìn sǝm wur a nJesu,
ɗe nǝ met koor sǝm mo jir.
nɗǝǝn ɗengnaan, kǝ nɗǝǝn nyil ɗesǝ,
ɓe mon njì kurum ntoom Jesu.

content: Wu Ɗee A Peeɓang

Mbǝmǝnǝ, wun ɗe wen wal nwun sǝ kaaɗi shidaar-shidaar ɓe wuu naa ncìn mbii ɗe dǝ wen nsat nee, wu cìn mo, ɓe an ashak kǝ wun sǝ. Ɓe wu sat a sekyeen kǝ cìn mbii ɗe gyet wen sat mo nwun ɗak. Jir kǝ ɗe baa an kuɗi ashak kǝ wun kas, ɓe wu shin ɗeɗes nNaan, kǝ wu kǝǝr wur nɗǝǝn pǝtuup fuu mo zak. Wu cìn ɗak shiɓal fuu mo, mbǝkǝ ɓam fuu nǝ ɗee ɗi a ɗegǝgam.
Mbǝɗe a Naan ɗewur kǝ cìn ɗak nɗǝǝn pǝtuup fuu mo shidaar-shidaar. A wur kǝ le kǝ nwun cìn mbii ɗe mo ret wur nyit. Wur nshín ɓal nwun mbǝkǝ nwun cìn mbii ɗeret nǝ mo ɗi.
Wu cìn mbii mo jir, baa a shi pwoo nɗoom-nɗoom kǝ ɓeetshik kas,

mbǝkǝ taji gurum mo naa bish fuu kas. Mbǝkǝ nwun ɗee ɗe a ɗeɓang kaa jep Naan ɗegǝgam mo sǝ, ɗe moo tong nɗǝǝn nyil ɗebish sǝ, kǝ nɗǝǝn gurum ɗe mo gam kǝ shikbish sǝ. Wu ɗee a peeɓang mɓut mmo nɗǝǝn nyil ɗesǝ nǝ, kaa peeɓang mǝ zar ɗe mo aɗeng sǝ.

Kaaɗi wuu satpwoo ɗeret mǝ seen nǝ mo sǝ. Katɗang wu cìn aasǝ, ɓe ghan nkatpee mbǝ leshap shi wun parpuus mǝ Kristi. Mbǝɗi parpuus mǝnǝ, ɓe nǝ nɗee agaak nee, ɗaar kǝ ɗak ɗe dǝ ghan kǝn cìn nǝ, baa nǝ a buu kas.
Koo ɗe mon nfet ghan, kǝ mo ɗoo toom fen kaa mbiizuum ɗe shang sǝ mbǝ shinzeen fuu nɗǝǝn Naan, ɓe nǝ ret nwen nyit, kǝ nǝ shang nwen ashak kǝ wun jir.
Nǝ aasǝ zak, nǝ ret kǝ wun, wu cìn retnyit ashak kǝ an zak.
Timoti Kǝ Epafradaitus
Katɗang Daa Jesu Kristi wur rǝɓet, ɓe wen kǝn lepan nǝ, an nlep Timoti shindǝm pee wun ɗe kǝkǝlak. Mbǝkǝ katɗang wur baaji, ɓe wen kǝlǝng pwoo ɗe nkaa tong fuu, kǝ nǝ caa an ɗi.
Baa nghan kǝ mee ngwe kaa wur sǝ kas, ɗewur kǝ shìn shin azeen-nzeen mbǝ sekyeen fuu.
Koor gurum nǝ mo ɗee a ncìn mbii ɗe mǝkáa fur mo ɓejee ɗak, baa mo kak sekyeen mǝ pwoo Jesu Kristi kas.
Wun shikáa fuu wuu man tong Timoti, mbǝɗe an kǝ wur, mun a kaa puun kǝ ɗyem nwur sǝ, ɗe muu cìn ɗak ashak mbǝ satpwoo ɗeret nǝ.
Mbǝmǝnǝ kǝn lepan, mbǝkǝ wen lep wur shindǝm pee wun ɗi kǝlak-kǝlak. kaɗang mman mbii ɗe nǝ kat an ɗi.
Wen shinzeen nɗǝǝn Daa nee, Baa nǝ ntong ɗes kas, ɓe wur nle kǝ nghan shikáa fen wen dǝm pee wun ɗi.

Wen kǝn pan nee, nǝ ret kǝ nghan lep Epafradaitus ɗyemnǝǝn fun, wur a shaarɗak fen, ɗewur kǝ cìn lek nǝ ashak kǝ an, shindǝm pee wun ɗi. Gyet a wun lep wur jì pee an ɗi, mbǝkǝ wur ɓam an ɗe nɗǝǝn ɗak mo.
Gyet wur kǝ fes lepan mbǝkǝ wur naa wun ɗe jir, ɗangɓe wur kǝ pǝtuup ɗewat mbǝɗe baa gyet wur nkoom kas kaaɗi gyet wu kǝlǝng sǝ.
Azeen-nzeen baa gyet wur nkoom kas, mbǝ gyet wur kus kǝ muut, ɗangɓe Naan wur naajeel wur. Baa Naan naa a jeel wur ɓejee kas, ɗangɓe kǝ wen jir, mbǝkǝ taji nkat pǝtuup ɗewat nkaa pǝtuup ɗewat kas.
Mbǝmǝnǝ, wen kǝn fes nlepan, mbǝkǝ nghan lep wur shindǝm pee wun ɗi. Mbǝkǝ nwun kat retnyit ɗe mbǝ baa naa wur shi yit fuu mo, mbǝkǝ pǝtuup mǝnǝ pan saam ɗe zak.
Mbǝmǝnǝ, wul a wur nɗǝǝn sǝm nDaa shi retnyit hakyeng. Wu shin ɗeɗes nkaan nen mǝnǝ mo.
Gyet ɗee ɗi a lee kǝ wur muut mbǝ ɗak Kristi. Gyet wur shin seen wur, mbǝkǝ wur ɓam an ɗe, nɗǝǝn ɗak ɗe baa wun shikáa fuu wu mak cìn nǝ kas.
